summary: Computes the axis-aligned bounding box and bounding sphere of a mesh by transforming its vertex data through the D3D device. Walks a linked list of mesh nodes, and for each node transforms every vertex (via the device object at dword_8B8F24) accumulating per-axis minima and maxima, then stores the eight corners, the three axis centers, and a sphere radius derived from the half-extent magnitude on the node. The animated path instead reads blended vertex data through an animation structure and interpolates toward the animation frame when the blend flag is set. After the list pass, the animation clock is advanced by the frame delta (dword_8B8F28) and clamped by mode, producing the blend factor used by the interpolation.

operations.description: Entry guard: the mesh-node list head at this+0x13C must be non-null before traversal starts.
Walk the mesh-node linked list; each node carries its next pointer at node+0x24 and a processed flag at node+0x4.
Node guard: the node flag field at node+0x4 must hold the marker bits, otherwise the node is skipped.
Initialize the per-axis minima to a large positive sentinel and maxima to a large negative sentinel before accumulating vertex bounds.
Static-path guard: when the mesh flags at this+0x14 do not contain the mask represented by the unk_800000 global, vertices are transformed directly without blending.
Iterate the mesh part array: part count at this+0x118, part data base at this+0x11C.
SingleCallWrapper_e0e0 begins processing of a mesh part.
Transform stride v38 is derived from the node field at node+0x18.
Iterate the vertices of the part; the part supplies the vertex count, the source vertex data, and the destination vertex buffer.
Transform each source vertex through the device vtable entry at dword_8B8F24, writing the transformed position into a scratch slot.
Accumulate per-axis minima and maxima from the transformed vertex coordinates.
Store the transformed position into the destination vertex buffer, then transform and copy the tangent/normal data from the source vertex.
Primitive-type dispatch on the part flag word: one of sub_55E320, sub_55DA50, or sub_55D900 is called depending on which flag bits are set.
When the mesh flags at this+0x14 contain the render-flag bit, sub_55EB30 is called for the part.
Wrapper_e0f0 finishes processing of the part.
Animated-path guard: when the mesh flags at this+0x14 carry the blend-animation markers, the list walk breaks out to update the animation clock instead.
Second pass over the mesh part array (count at this+0x118, base at this+0x11C) for the blended-vertex path.
SingleCallWrapper_e0e0 begins processing of a part in the blended path.
Iterate blended vertices; each bone index selects a blend-offset region within the animation data reachable through the animation struct at this+0x144.
Transform each blended vertex through the device vtable entry at dword_8B8F24 using the selected blend offset.
When the blend flag is set, interpolate the transformed vertex toward the animation-frame data reachable through the animation struct at this+0x144 using the blend factor.
Accumulate per-axis minima and maxima for the blended vertices and store the blended position into the destination vertex buffer.
Transform and copy the tangent/normal data for each blended vertex through the device vtable entry at dword_8B8F24.
Primitive-type dispatch on the part flag word for the blended path: one of sub_55E320, sub_55DA50, or sub_55D900 is called.
When the mesh flags at this+0x14 contain the render-flag bit, sub_55EB30 is called for the blended part.
Wrapper_e0f0 finishes processing of the blended part.
Write the accumulated minimum coordinates into the first bounding-box corner at this+0x1C/0x20/0x24.
Compute the three axis center coordinates as midpoints of the accumulated extrema and store them at this+0xDC/0xE0/0xE4.
Write the remaining seven bounding-box corner coordinates (21 floats) at this+0x28 through this+0x78 from the accumulated minima and maxima.
Compute the bounding-sphere radius as the square root of the sum of half-extent squares and store it at this+0x18.
Clear the node processed flag at node+0x4 and advance to the next node via node+0x24, continuing the list walk.
Exit the node list walk when the next-node pointer becomes null, using the list head field at this+0x13C.
Animation-mode guards on the animation struct at this+0x144: mode not equal to forward, mode equal to reverse, and a nonzero part count gate the clock update and interpolation path.

Advance the animation clock at anim+0x8 by the frame delta read from dword_8B8F28, clamp it to the duration at anim+0x4 according to the mode at anim+0x0, reset on completion, and update the mesh flags at this+0x14.
Blend factor is computed as the animation progress (anim+0x8) divided by the duration (anim+0x4), used by the animated vertex interpolation.
